mapper.select: -- 客户信息管理 SELECT hba.bp_attachment_id as source_id, 'HLS_BP_ATTACHMENT' as source_type, hba.document_name, ( SELECT wm_concat( fa.file_name ) FROM fnd_atm_attachment fa, fnd_atm_attachment_multi fam WHERE hba.bp_attachment_id = fam.table_pk_value AND fam.table_name = 'HLS_BP_ATTACHMENT' AND fa.attachment_id = fam.attachment_id ) AS file_name FROM hls_bp_attachment hba , prj_project_bp ppb WHERE 1 = 1 AND ppb.bp_id = hba.bp_id AND ppb.bp_type = 'TENANT' AND ppb.project_id = #{projectId} union all -- 客户财报信息管理 select v.* from (SELECT h.header_id as source_id, 'HLS_BP_FINANCIAL_HEADER' as source_type, hr.fin_statement_name as document_name, ( SELECT wm_concat( fa.file_name ) FROM fnd_atm_attachment fa, fnd_atm_attachment_multi fam WHERE h.header_id = fam.table_pk_value AND fam.table_name = 'HLS_BP_FINANCIAL_HEADER' AND fa.attachment_id = fam.attachment_id ) AS file_name FROM hls_bp_financial_header h, hls_web_excel_calc_result hr, hls_web_excel hwe , prj_project_bp ppb WHERE h.header_id = hr.source_document_id AND hr.source_document_category = 'FINANCIAL_REPORT' AND hwe.excel_id = hr.excel_id AND ppb.bp_id = h.bp_id AND ppb.bp_type = 'TENANT' AND ppb.project_id = #{projectId} and rownum=1 order by h.export_date desc ) v union all -- 租赁物管理 SELECT hlia.lease_item_attachment_id AS source_id, 'HLS_LEASE_ITEM_ATTACHMENT' AS source_type, hlia.document_name, ( SELECT wm_concat( fa.file_name ) FROM fnd_atm_attachment fa, fnd_atm_attachment_multi fam WHERE fa.attachment_id = fam.attachment_id AND fam.table_name = 'HLS_LEASE_ITEM_ATTACHMENT' AND hlia.lease_item_attachment_id = fam.table_pk_value ) AS file_name FROM HLS_LEASE_ITEM_ATTACHMENT hlia, prj_project_lease_item ppli, hls_lease_item hli WHERE hlia.lease_item_id = hli.lease_item_id AND ppli.lease_item_id = hli.lease_item_id AND ppli.project_id = #{projectId} AND hli.LEASE_ITEM_TYPE = 'LEASE' AND hli.enabled_flag = 'Y' union all -- 抵质押物管理 SELECT hlia.lease_item_attachment_id AS source_id, 'HLS_LEASE_ITEM_ATTACHMENT' AS source_type, hlia.document_name, ( SELECT wm_concat( fa.file_name ) FROM fnd_atm_attachment fa, fnd_atm_attachment_multi fam WHERE fa.attachment_id = fam.attachment_id AND fam.table_name = 'HLS_LEASE_ITEM_ATTACHMENT' AND hlia.lease_item_attachment_id = fam.table_pk_value ) AS file_name FROM HLS_LEASE_ITEM_ATTACHMENT hlia, prj_project_chance_mp ppcm, hls_lease_item hli WHERE hlia.lease_item_id = hli.lease_item_id AND ppcm.lease_item_id = hli.lease_item_id AND ppcm.project_id = #{projectId} AND hli.LEASE_ITEM_TYPE IN ( 'MORTGAGE', 'PLEDGE' ) AND hli.enabled_flag = 'Y' union all -- 资产价值重估 SELECT lal.asset_ln_id AS source_id, 'lease_asset_ln' AS source_type, '资产价值重估文件' AS document_name, ( SELECT wm_concat( fa.file_name ) FROM fnd_atm_attachment fa, fnd_atm_attachment_multi fam WHERE fa.attachment_id = fam.attachment_id AND fam.table_name = 'lease_asset_ln' AND lal.asset_ln_id = fam.table_pk_value ) AS FILE_NAME FROM lease_asset_ln lal, lease_asset_hd lah WHERE lal.ASSET_HD_ID = lah.ASSET_HD_ID AND lah.MODIFY_DATE = (select max(h.MODIFY_DATE) FROM lease_asset_ln l, lease_asset_hd h WHERE l.ASSET_HD_ID = h.ASSET_HD_ID and l.LEASE_ITEM_ID = lal.lease_item_id ) AND lal.LEASE_ITEM_ID in ( select ppcm.lease_item_id from prj_project_chance_mp ppcm where ppcm.project_id = #{projectId} union select ppli.lease_item_id from prj_project_lease_item ppli where ppli.project_id = #{projectId} ) -- 保险文件管理 union all SELECT t1.insure_id AS source_id, 'PRJ_PROJECT_INSURE' AS source_type, '保险管理文件' AS document_name, ( SELECT wm_concat( fa.file_name ) FROM fnd_atm_attachment fa, fnd_atm_attachment_multi fam WHERE t1.insure_id = fam.table_pk_value AND fam.table_name = 'PRJ_PROJECT_INSURE' AND fa.attachment_id = fam.attachment_id ) AS file_name FROM PRJ_PROJECT_INSURE t1 where t1.project_id IN( SELECT PP.PROJECT_ID FROM PRJ_PROJECT PP WHERE PP.REF_PROJECT_ID = #{projectId}) -- 项目方案管理 union all SELECT hra.marketing_attachment_id as source_id, 'HLS_MARKETING_REPORT_DOCX' as source_type, hra.document_name, ( SELECT wm_concat( fa.file_name ) FROM fnd_atm_attachment fa, fnd_atm_attachment_multi fam WHERE fa.attachment_id = fam.attachment_id AND fam.table_name IN ( 'hls_report_attachment', 'HLS_MARKETING_REPORT_DOCX' ) AND hra.marketing_attachment_id = fam.table_pk_value ) AS file_name FROM HLS_REPORT_ATTACHMENT hra, prj_project pp WHERE hra.attachment_category IN ( 'MARKETING_REPORT_ATT', 'HLS_MARKETING_REPORT_DOCX' ) and pp.marketing_report_id = hra.marketing_report_id and pp.project_id = #{projectId} -- 立项 union all SELECT hra.chance_attachment_id as source_id, case when hra.attachment_category = 'HLS_CREDIT_CHANCE_DOCX' then 'HLS_CREDIT_CHANCE_DOCX' else 'HLS_CREDIT_LINE_CHANCE' end as source_type, hra.document_name, ( SELECT wm_concat( fa.file_name ) FROM fnd_atm_attachment fa, fnd_atm_attachment_multi fam WHERE fa.attachment_id = fam.attachment_id AND fam.table_name IN ( 'hls_credit_line_chance', 'HLS_CREDIT_CHANCE_DOCX' ) AND hra.CHANCE_ATTACHMENT_ID = fam.table_pk_value ) file_name FROM hls_credit_line_attach hra, prj_project pp WHERE hra.attachment_category IN ( 'CHANCE_ATT', 'HLS_CREDIT_CHANCE_DOCX' ) AND hra.chance_id = pp.chance_id AND pp.project_id = #{projectId} -- 尽调报告撰写 union all SELECT ppa.project_attachment_id as source_id, case when ppa.project_attachment_category = 'PRJ_SEND_REVIEW_REPORT' then 'PRJ_PROJECT_ATTACHMENT' else ppa.project_attachment_category end as source_type, ppa.document_name, ( SELECT wm_concat( fat.file_name ) FROM fnd_atm_attachment fat, fnd_atm_attachment_multi faam WHERE fat.attachment_id = faam.attachment_id AND faam.table_name IN ( 'HLS_PRJ_PROJECT_DOCX1', 'HLS_PRJ_PROJECT_DOCX2', 'HLS_PRJ_PROJECT_DOCX3', 'PRJ_PROJECT_ATTACHMENT' ) AND faam.table_pk_value = ppa.project_attachment_id ) AS file_name FROM prj_project_attachment ppa WHERE ppa.project_attachment_category IN ( 'HLS_PRJ_PROJECT_DOCX1', 'HLS_PRJ_PROJECT_DOCX2', 'HLS_PRJ_PROJECT_DOCX3', 'PRJ_SEND_REVIEW_REPORT' ) AND ppa.project_id = #{projectId} -- 关税附件，租后检查 union all SELECT ca.attachment_id as source_id, 'jczl_common_attachment' as source_type, ca.document_name, ( SELECT wm_concat( faa.file_name ) AS modelName FROM fnd_atm_attachment faa, fnd_atm_attachment_multi faam WHERE faam.record_id = faa.source_pk_value AND faam.table_pk_value = ca.attachment_id AND faam.table_name = 'jczl_common_attachment' ) AS file_name FROM jczl_common_attachment ca , con_contract_tariff_info ccti, con_contract cc , prj_project pp WHERE ca.source_category in ('con_contract_tariff_info','prj_check') AND ca.source_id = ccti.tariff_id and cc.contract_id = ccti.contract_id and cc.project_id = pp.project_id AND pp.ref_project_id = #{projectId} union all -- 合同签约文件 SELECT fpa.project_attachment_id as source_id, 'FCT_PROJECT_ATTACHMENT' as source_type, fpa.document_name, ( SELECT wm_concat( fat.file_name ) FROM fnd_atm_attachment fat, fnd_atm_attachment_multi faam WHERE fat.attachment_id = faam.attachment_id AND faam.table_name = 'FCT_PROJECT_ATTACHMENT' AND faam.table_pk_value = fpa.project_attachment_id ) AS file_name FROM fct_project_attachment fpa WHERE 1 = 1 AND fpa.project_id in (select pp.project_id from prj_project pp where pp.ref_project_id = #{projectId}) union all -- 付款申请 SELECT ppa.csh_attcahment_id as source_id, 'csh_payment_attachment' as source_type, ppa.document_name, ( SELECT wm_concat( fa.file_name ) FROM fnd_atm_attachment fa, fnd_atm_attachment_multi fam WHERE fa.attachment_id = fam.attachment_id AND fam.table_name = 'csh_payment_attachment' AND ppa.csh_attcahment_id = fam.table_pk_value ) AS file_name FROM csh_payment_attachment ppa WHERE ppa.project_attachment_category = 'CON_PAYMENT' AND ppa.payment_req_id in (select ch.payment_req_id from csh_payment_req_hd ch,prj_project pp where pp.project_id = ch.source_doc_id and pp.ref_project_id = #{projectId}) union all -- 存续期审批/业务变更执行 SELECT hda.duration_attachment_id as source_id, 'HLS_DURATION_ATTACHMENT' as source_type, hda.document_name, ( SELECT wm_concat( fat.file_name ) FROM fnd_atm_attachment fat, fnd_atm_attachment_multi faam WHERE fat.attachment_id = faam.attachment_id AND faam.table_name = 'HLS_DURATION_ATTACHMENT' AND faam.table_pk_value = hda.duration_attachment_id ) file_name FROM hls_duration_attachment hda WHERE hda.attachment_category in ('BUSINESS_CHANGE','FINANCIAL_TERMS') AND hda.hd_id in (SELECT t.hd_id FROM hls_duration_hd t, prj_project pp WHERE pp.project_id = t.project_id AND pp.ref_project_id = #{projectId}) union all -- 租赁物巡查附件 SELECT pli.lease_info_id AS source_id, 'prj_lease_inspect' AS source_type, '租赁物巡查文件' AS document_name, ( SELECT wm_concat( fa.file_name ) FROM fnd_atm_attachment fa, fnd_atm_attachment_multi fam WHERE fa.attachment_id = fam.attachment_id AND fam.table_name = 'prj_lease_inspect' AND pli.lease_info_id = fam.table_pk_value ) AS file_name FROM prj_lease_info pli WHERE 1 = 1 AND pli.prj_lease_id IN ( SELECT p.prj_lease_id FROM prj_lease_inspect p, prj_project pp WHERE p.project_id = pp.project_id AND pp.ref_project_id = #{projectId} ) union all -- 承租人风险预警 SELECT hra.risk_attachment_id as source_id, 'plm_risk_warning' as source_type, hra.document_name, ( SELECT wm_concat( fa.file_name ) FROM fnd_atm_attachment fa, fnd_atm_attachment_multi fam WHERE fa.attachment_id = fam.attachment_id AND fam.table_name IN ( 'plm_risk_warning' ) AND hra.risk_attachment_id = fam.table_pk_value ) AS file_name FROM plm_risk_attachment hra WHERE hra.attachment_category IN ( 'RISK_ATT' ) AND hra.risk_warning_id in (SELECT p.risk_warning_id FROM plm_risk_warning p, prj_project_bp ppb WHERE p.bp_id = ppb.bp_id AND ppb.bp_type = 'TENANT' AND ppb.project_id = #{projectId}) union all -- 资产处置附件 SELECT hlia.ASSETS_DISPOSAL_ATTCH_ID AS source_id, 'assets_disposal_attch' AS source_type, nvl( hlia.document_name, '资产处理文件' ) AS document_name, ( SELECT wm_concat( fa.file_name ) FROM fnd_atm_attachment fa, fnd_atm_attachment_multi fam WHERE fa.attachment_id = fam.attachment_id AND fam.table_name = 'assets_disposal_attch' AND hlia.ASSETS_DISPOSAL_ATTCH_ID = fam.table_pk_value ) AS FILE_NAME FROM assets_disposal_attch hlia WHERE hlia.ASSETS_DISPOSAL_ID IN ( SELECT ad.ASSETS_DISPOSAL_ID FROM assets_disposal ad, prj_project p WHERE ad.PROJECT_ID = p.PROJECT_ID AND p.DATA_CLASS = 'VIRTUAL_CON' AND P.ref_project_id = #{projectId} ) union all -- 诉讼管理文件 SELECT lmt.LITIGATION_MANAGEMENT_ID AS source_id, 'litigation_management' AS source_type, '诉讼管理文件' AS document_name , ( SELECT wm_concat( fat.file_name ) FROM fnd_atm_attachment fat, fnd_atm_attachment_multi faam WHERE fat.attachment_id = faam.attachment_id AND faam.table_name = 'litigation_management' AND faam.table_pk_value = lmt.LITIGATION_MANAGEMENT_ID ) file_name FROM litigation_management lmt, prj_project pp WHERE lmt.PROJECT_ID = pp.PROJECT_ID AND pp.ref_project_id = #{projectId}
